description.zh: 需要接入全站加速IPA的域名，仅支持单个启用。
description.en: The domain name to accelerate with DCDN IPA. You can enable only one domain name at a time.

title.zh: 启用停用IPA服务的加速域名

descriptions.zh:
> 
> - 如果您的域名处于非法状态或域名对应账户欠费，您将无法正常调用该接口启用加速域名。
>- 单用户调用频率：20次/秒。
descriptions.en:
> - The call to enable the accelerated domain name fails if the domain name is in an invalid state or the associated account has an overdue payment.
>
> - The call frequency is limited to 20 calls per second per user.
